from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import open_run, resolve_channels, sdh_fft, sdh_onset

fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(14, 7))
records = []
for row, rid in enumerate((6, 7)):
    r = open_run(Path('data') / str(rid))
    ch = {c.cid:c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col('magnet_field'); I = r.col('sr0_X')/ch['sr0'].gain
    R = (r.col('sr1_X')/ch['sr1'].gain)/I
    records.append((rid, B, R))
    ax[row,0].plot(B, r.col('sr1_X')*1e6, lw=.7)
    ax[row,0].set(xlabel='B (T)', ylabel='raw sr1 X (uV)', title=f'Run {rid}, B_1-B_2')
    ax[row,1].plot(B,I*1e9,label='drain'); ax[row,1].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='drain current (nA)')
    ax[row,2].plot(B,r.col('k_2400_tg_curr')*1e12,label='TG',lw=.6)
    ax[row,2].plot(B,r.col('k_2400_bg_curr')*1e12,label='BG',lw=.6)
    ax[row,2].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='gate current (pA)'); ax[row,2].legend()
    print(f'Run {rid}: {r.rows} points, interrupted={r.interrupted}, R signed {R.min():.1f}..{R.max():.1f} Ohm; I {I.min()*1e9:.3f}..{I.max()*1e9:.3f} nA; T {np.min(r.col("T_sample")):.3f}..{np.max(r.col("T_sample")):.3f} K')
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig('hera_scratch/spot_raw.png',dpi=140); plt.show()
fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(12,8))
for row,(rid,B,R) in enumerate(records):
    ax[row,0].plot(B,R,lw=.7); ax[row,0].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='signed V/I (Ohm)',title=f'Run {rid}: no absolute-value rectification')
    for lo in (1.5,2.,3.):
        f,p=sdh_fft(R[:,None],B,b_range=(lo,10),log=False,nfft=2048,bg_degree=3)
        spec=p[0]; sel=(f>3)&(f<60)
        pk,_=find_peaks(spec)
        pk=sorted([k for k in pk if 3<f[k]<60],key=lambda k:-spec[k])[:5]
        print(f'Run {rid} signed FFT B={lo}..10 T: nominal resolution {1/(1/lo-.1):.2f} T; peak frequencies '+str([(round(f[k],2),round(spec[k],1)) for k in pk]))
        ax[row,1].plot(f[sel],spec[sel]/max(spec[sel]),label=f'{lo}..10 T')
    try:
        onset=sdh_onset(R,B,b_lo=1.,r_full_scale=5000,bg_degree=3)
        print(f'Run {rid}: '+onset.summary())
    except ValueError as exc: print(f'Run {rid}: onset inconclusive: {exc}')
    ax[row,1].set(xlabel='F (T)',ylabel='normalized FFT amplitude',title='Window dependence; peaks are not band assignments'); ax[row,1].legend()
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig('hera_scratch/spot_analysis.png',dpi=140); plt.show()

**Read / next decision (plan step 4):** Both field traces support a fan: drain current is 9.843–9.935 nA (run 6) and 9.809–9.931 nA (run 7), temperatures 1.165–1.292 K; signed resistance spans -32.9–529.6 and -0.4–586.9 Ohm, far below the 5 kOhm nominal range. At B=2–10 T, electron FFT peaks near 7.5, 15, 22.5 and 30 T could include harmonics; hole peaks near 5 and 12.5 T depend on the window. The helper's 1 T onset is censored at the analysis boundary, not a measured onset. Neither peak count nor proximity to inherited model estimates establishes stacking. Signed negative excursions are retained; Hall admixture cannot be removed without opposite field or transverse contacts.

Proceed with a D*=0 Landau fan over n*=-1.2..3.2, recording the gate path explicitly. Dense coverage starts at 2 T, where the nominal spectral resolution over 2–10 T is 2.5 T; runs 6/7 retain the finer low-field cuts. Follow branches versus gate voltage to test harmonics, multiple bands, and the two-ridge inhomogeneity confound. The capacitance ratio is measured, absolute capacitance is still a prior, and the resistance-minimum D offset is provisional. A resistance increase with D alone does not establish a gap or stacking. Only B_1-B_2 is independently contacted, so inferred internal domains cannot receive separate region verdicts.

## HERA — Landau fan across both carrier signs (plan step 4)

> **05:23** · Landau fan B\_1-B\_2: D\*=0, n\*=-1.2..+3.2e12, B 0..10 T, 54x111 pts, base T, Si 0 V, 3 s dwell · **ETA ~12:53** (≈7h30m)

Runs 6/7 show oscillatory B_1–B_2 transport with stable 9.81–9.94 nA drain current and peaks below 600 Ohm; the electron peaks near 7.5/15/22.5/30 T could be harmonics, so a fixed-density FFT is not a stacking verdict (ana cells 14–16). This fan follows branch motion and crossings versus gate voltage on the run-5 D*=0 trajectory, spanning both CNP ridges and both carrier signs. **Calibration caveat:** c_bg/c_tg=0.772765 and the ridge intercept are measured; the absolute capacitance remains geometry-anchored and D*=0 is inferred from a resistance minimum. Save/plot gate voltages as primary coordinates; do not infer stacking or recalibrate density by assuming a candidate's degeneracy.

**Coverage and resolution:** 111 gate pairs at n*=-1.2..3.2 ×10^12 cm^-2, step 0.04; B=0,1,1.5 T context rows, then 31 rows uniform in 1/B from 2 to 5 T, then 5.25..10 T by 0.25 T (54 rows total). At 2 T the nominal fourfold density period is 0.193×10^12 cm^-2 (~4.8 samples); inverse-field spacing 0.01 T^-1 gives ~3.3 samples for F=30 T and nominal 2–10 T resolution 2.5 T. High harmonics above ~50 T and detailed fan structure below 2 T are excluded; consult the fine spot sweeps there. A comparable dense 1–2 T fan extension would add ~50 rows / ~5 hours. Density outside this window is excluded by the operating box or the small endpoint margin; it will not be pursued by extending limits. This is one independently measured contact pair, not spatially resolved access to the two inferred internal regions.

**Preflight and price:** cell 18 SAFETIES (exec 10) numerically matches the card, within the rig's 14 T maximum; cells 44/46 document near-zero handoff and bound kernel, with existing E1 grant. Recheck live validators, base thermometry freshness, heaters off, Si 0 V, magnet output/PS on, drive 1 V at 13.777 Hz, and committed pacing before writes. Fixed sr1 100 uV range gives 10 kOhm nominal headroom near neutrality; 3 s dwell is 10 tau at 0.3 s/24 dB. Ramp 0→10 T at 1/7.3 T/min costs 73 min minimum. Run 5 ordinary point intervals were 1.10 s with 1 s dwell; allow 3.20 s/point with added readbacks (5994 points ≈320 min), ~12 min row overhead and ~15% margin. Fields run upward only and end at 10 T, gates at the high-density endpoint for the next decision.

**Checkpoints:** inspect first points (1/5/20) and first three complete rows for current, leakage, railing, phase and handoff-baseline changes; then read hera-watch every ~30 min and around 2/4/6/8 T. Per-point guards interrupt on >1 nA gate current, current loss, near-full-scale X, off-base T or setpoint/readback mismatch; all followed channels have live plots. If branches remain absent by 4–6 T, quantify contrast and decide whether the remaining time is justified. Preserve signed V/I (negative excursions in run 6), inspect raw maps before derived FFTs; multiple branches must be separated from harmonics and two-CNP inhomogeneity before a call. **Magnet-specific abort:** a kernel interrupt does not stop an in-flight supply ramp; alert Zack if interrupted during field motion and re-read actual state before any recovery. No automatic return ramp.

# Plan step 4: D*=0 Landau fan, both signs; calibration remains provisional.
# All preconditions and every planned setpoint are checked before any write.
import json
from pathlib import Path

for _label, _param, _limits in [
    ('TG', k_tg.volt, (-0.3, 1.0)), ('BG', k_bg.volt, (-1.3, 2.0)),
    ('Si ramped', dc205.smart_voltage, (-25., 25.)),
    ('Si raw', dc205.voltage, (-25., 25.)),
    ('field', magnet.field, (-10., 10.)),
    ('sample setpoint', heater.sample_setpoint, (0., 100.)),
    ('vaporizer setpoint', heater.vaporizer_setpoint, (0., 100.))]:
    _actual = (float(_param.vals._min_value), float(_param.vals._max_value))
    print(f'validator {_label}: expected {_limits}, actual {_actual}')
    assert _actual == _limits, f'SAFETIES mismatch: {_label}'
assert B_SESSION_CAP == 10.0 and T_SESSION_CAP == 100.0
assert k_tg is k_2400_tg and k_bg is k_2400_bg and k_si is dc205.smart_voltage
for _name in ('T_sample', 'T_vaporizer'):
    assert_thermometry_live(_name, VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[_name], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _Tv0, _B0 = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field()
_Si0 = k_si()
_ranges = (heater.sample_range(), heater.vaporizer_range())
print(f'expected Ts 1.0..1.5 K, Tv 0.6..1.6 K, |B|<0.02 T, Si 0 V, heaters off; '
      f'actual {_T0:.3f}, {_Tv0:.3f} K, {_B0:+.5f} T, {_Si0:+.4f} V, {_ranges}')
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and 0.6 <= _Tv0 <= 1.6 and abs(_Tv0-_T0)<0.6
assert abs(_B0)<0.02 and abs(_Si0)<0.01 and _ranges == (0,0)
_ps, _out = magnet.persistent_switch_on(), magnet.output_enabled()
print(f'magnet PS/output expected True/True; actual {_ps}/{_out}')
assert _ps and _out
print(f'DC205 expected RNGE2/output1/rate0.5; actual {dc205.voltage_range()}/{dc205.output()}/{dc205.ramp_rate}')
assert dc205.voltage_range()==2 and dc205.output()==1 and dc205.ramp_rate==0.5
print(f'gate step expected 0.005/0.005 V; actual {k_tg.volt.step}/{k_bg.volt.step}; '
      f'NPLC expected 1/1, actual {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()}')
assert k_tg.volt.step==0.005 and k_bg.volt.step==0.005
assert k_tg.nplci()==1 and k_bg.nplci()==1
_expected_wiring = {'source':'T_0','drain':'B_3','sr1+':'B_1','sr1-':'B_2',
                    'sr2+':'n.c.','sr2-':'n.c.','sr3+':'n.c.','sr3-':'n.c.'}
print(f'hardwired expected {_expected_wiring}; actual {WIRING}')
assert WIRING==_expected_wiring and 'mux' not in globals()
assert meas_config['sr0_gain']==-1e6 and meas_config.get('sr1_gain',1)==1
assert meas_config['bias_resistor']==100e6 and meas_config['bias_channel']=='sr1'
_amp, _freq = sr1.amplitude(), sr1.frequency()
print(f'drive expected 1 V / 13.777 Hz; actual {_amp}/{_freq}')
assert abs(_amp-1.0)<0.001 and abs(_freq-13.777)<0.01
for _li in (sr0,sr1):
    _tau, _slope = _li.time_constant(), _li.filter_slope()
    print(f'{_li.name} expected tau 0.3 s / slope 24 dB; actual {_tau}/{_slope}')
    assert _tau==0.3 and _slope==24
print(f'sr0 sensitivity expected 0.020 V; actual {sr0.sensitivity()}')
assert sr0.sensitivity()==0.020
print(f'gate starting readbacks (will be set): TG={k_tg.volt():+.5f}, BG={k_bg.volt():+.5f} V')

# Explicit immutable copy of the run-5 coordinate convention. n in SI internally.
_FCAL = dict(c_tg=0.0027960593093052633, c_bg=0.002160696465377614,
             n_offset=-0.08937933224099137e16, D_offset=-0.013e9)
_fan_cal = GateCalibration(**_FCAL)
fan_n = np.linspace(-1.2,3.2,111)*1e16
fan_D = 0.0
_qsum = cst.e*(fan_n-_FCAL['n_offset'])
_qdiff = 2*cst.epsilon_0*(fan_D-_FCAL['D_offset'])
fan_tg = (_qsum+_qdiff)/(2*_FCAL['c_tg'])
fan_bg = (_qsum-_qdiff)/(2*_FCAL['c_bg'])
fan_B = np.r_[0.,1.,1.5,field_invB(2.,5.,31),np.arange(5.25,10.001,0.25)]
assert len(fan_B)==54 and len(fan_n)==111 and np.all(np.diff(fan_B)>0)
assert np.allclose(_fan_cal.density(fan_tg,fan_bg),fan_n)
assert np.allclose(_fan_cal.displacement_field(fan_tg,fan_bg),fan_D,atol=1e-6)
for _p,_vs in ((k_tg.volt,fan_tg),(k_bg.volt,fan_bg),(magnet.field,fan_B)):
    for _v in _vs: _p.validate(float(_v))
print(f'54 x 111 = 5994 points; TG {fan_tg.min():+.6f}..{fan_tg.max():+.6f} V; '
      f'BG {fan_bg.min():+.6f}..{fan_bg.max():+.6f} V; B 0..10 T; D*=0, n* -1.2..3.2e12')
print(f'field ramp floor from {_B0:.4f} T to 10 T: {(abs(_B0)+10)*7.3:.1f} min; total budget 7h30m')

# No changes to gate pacing, limits, excitation, time constants or Si.
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
_fan_sens = sr1.sensitivity()
assert _fan_sens == 100e-6
fan_B_readback = qcodes.Parameter('fan_B_readback',get_cmd=magnet.field,unit='T')
fan_TG_readback = qcodes.Parameter('fan_TG_readback',get_cmd=k_tg.volt,unit='V')
fan_BG_readback = qcodes.Parameter('fan_BG_readback',get_cmd=k_bg.volt,unit='V')
mc = dict(meas_config)
mc.update({'Si (V)':_Si0,'sample_temperature:':_T0,'sr1_gain':1.0,
           'gate_calibration_SI':_FCAL,'calibration_status':'ratio/CNP from run5; absolute scale geometry prior; D-zero inferred',
           'lockin_settling':{'sr0_tau_s':0.3,'sr1_tau_s':0.3,'slope_dB':24,'point_dwell_s':3.0},
           'comments':'landau-fan D*=0; n* -1.2..3.2e12; B 0,1,1.5, inverse-B 2..5, 5.25..10 T; base; Si0'})
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment('plan step 4; B_1-B_2; source T_0 drain B_3; base T; Si=0 V; D*=0; '
              'n*=-1.2..3.2e12 cm^-2 in 0.04 steps; 54 B rows x 111 gate pairs; '
              'run5 calibration provisional; sr1 100uV; 3s dwell; B end 10T; gates end high-density point')
# Column order: time, B set, TG set, BG set, followed channels below.
_fan_follow = [T_sample,T_vaporizer,k_tg.curr,k_bg.curr,sr0.X,sr0.P,sr1.X,sr1.P,
               fan_B_readback,fan_TG_readback,fan_BG_readback]
for _p in _fan_follow:
    s.fp(_p) # raw X stored; analysis applies metadata gains once
    s.plot('time',_p)

_fan_count = [0]
_fan_guard_failures = []
def fan_prepoint(station):
    # Freshness checked before each row's first measurement; temperatures checked every point below.
    if _fan_count[0] % len(fan_n) == 0:
        for _name in ('T_sample','T_vaporizer'):
            assert_thermometry_live(_name,VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[_name],max_age=15,max_period=12)

def fan_guard(station,data):
    # Guard runs after a completed point, before any next field command.
    a=np.asarray(data,dtype=float)
    _, b, tg, bg, ts, tv, itg, ibg, x0, p0, x1, p1, br, tgr, bgr = a
    current=x0/mc['sr0_gain']
    problems=[]
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(a)): problems.append('nonfinite data')
    if abs(itg)>1e-9 or abs(ibg)>1e-9: problems.append('gate-current >1nA')
    if not (1.0<=ts<=1.5 and 0.6<=tv<=1.6): problems.append('temperature off base')
    if not 8e-9<=current<=12e-9: problems.append('drain-current outside 8..12nA')
    if abs(x1)>=0.90*_fan_sens or abs(x0)>=0.90*0.020: problems.append('lock-in near full scale')
    if abs(br-b)>0.03: problems.append('field tracking >30mT')
    if abs(tgr-tg)>0.002 or abs(bgr-bg)>0.002: problems.append('gate tracking >2mV')
    _fan_count[0]+=1
    if problems:
        _fan_guard_failures.append((_fan_count[0],problems))
        print(f'FAN STOP point {_fan_count[0]}, B={br:.5f}: {problems}',flush=True)
        station.interrupt_requested=True
    if _fan_count[0] in (1,5,20) or _fan_count[0]%len(fan_n)==0:
        print(f'FAN CHECK point {_fan_count[0]}/5994 B={br:.5f} T '
              f'T={ts:.3f}/{tv:.3f} K I={current*1e9:.3f}nA '
              f'gate I={itg*1e12:+.1f}/{ibg*1e12:+.1f}pA X1={x1*1e6:+.3f}uV',flush=True)
s.register_run_before(fan_prepoint,())
s.register_run_after(fan_guard,())
s.ramp(k_bg.volt,float(fan_bg[0])); s.ramp(k_tg.volt,float(fan_tg[0]))
interruptible_sleep(10)
fan_result=s.multimegasweep([magnet.field],[fan_B], [k_tg.volt,k_bg.volt],[fan_tg,fan_bg],
                            slow_delay=3.,fast_delay=3.)
print(f'FAN COMPLETE file_id={fan_result.id}; interrupted={fan_result.metadata.get("interrupted")}')
print(f'actual end B={magnet.field():+.5f} T, TG={k_tg.volt():+.5f} V, '
      f'BG={k_bg.volt():+.5f} V, Si={k_si():+.4f} V; Ts/Tv={T_sample():.3f}/{T_vaporizer():.3f} K')
# Hold endpoint for analysis / possible return scan. No automatic closeout or recovery moves.

B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.arange(10.0, 0.2999, -0.02), 4))[::-1]   # 10 -> 0.3 T, 20 mT
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity: 50 uV = 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA (R(B=0) ~ 250-300 Ohm near the CNP side; MR + SdH maxima at 10 T size the headroom).
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check hole: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 10 -> 0.3 T, 20 mT, sr1 50 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'hole side: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 10 -> 0.3 T uniform-B 20 mT (ride-down); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 0.3 T — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
